title: When Annotators Disagree, Topology Explains: Mapper, a Topological Tool for Exploring Text Embedding Geometry and Ambiguity
reasoning: The paper focuses on using a topological tool (Mapper) to analyze how language models represent ambiguity and annotator disagreement in embedding spaces. While it uses offensive language detection as a case study, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a subject of benchmarking or research.
